passages.text: Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.
passages.note: Permission to set grief aside and share joy

passages.text: But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.
passages.note: Fear of being unforgivable; mercy after repeated failure
